question.text: Distributors of a Category III AIF must assess:

answer.text: Suitability of each scheme for their clients, based on operations, strategy, and risk-return profile

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.82), distributors must understand the operations and strategy of each Category III AIF scheme and assess its risk-return profile and suitability for every client on a case-by-case basis. The Trap: Looking only at commissions, past returns, or fund size does not meet the suitability obligation set out in the workbook. Note: Page 344 reinforces that investor interest, risk profiling, and suitability must drive recommendations; commissions should not be the basis for recommending a scheme.
